name: Chasm
description: Bombed-out Los Angeles built around a collapsed structure, street ruins and a subway section.
dynamics: A hanging bus and elevator can be dropped, changing traversal and creating hazards.
connections: Uses destroyed-Los-Angeles scenery tied to the opening campaign area.
easter_eggs: Developer-name signage and environmental jokes appear around the subway.

name: Flooded
combat: Mixed; water routes and close-medium fights
description: Devastated urban area after a dam collapse, with partially submerged streets, vehicles and buildings.
dynamics: Players can enter the water; floating vehicles shift and affect access to higher routes.
connections: Visually echoes the flooded Caracas events associated with Legends Never Die.
easter_eggs: A teddy bear is hidden around the office/ventilation area.

name: Freight
description: Rail yard and factory transport depot with train cars, warehouses, alleys and an underground flank.
dynamics: Doors, a movable cart/gate route and a shootable ladder alter access and cover.
connections: Grounded industrial multiplayer setting.
easter_eggs: Includes a hidden MC Hammer reference and teddy bear.

name: Octane
description: Deserted Las Vegas roadside district around a gas station, buildings and open streets.
dynamics: The gas station can be destroyed to change cover; a trailer can reveal a care package.
connections: Shares the Las Vegas setting used later in Sin City.
easter_eggs: Environmental jokes and signs are scattered around the businesses.

name: Overlord
description: Federation satellite outpost with open desert sightlines, bunkers and a central drone facility.
dynamics: Doors on the central building can be opened or closed to control movement.
connections: Uses the Chilean satellite-installation setting associated with Severed Ties.
easter_eggs: Two teddy bears can be found in a box in the tunnel.

name: Prison Break
description: Jungle prison construction site with cliffs, water, vegetation and multi-level routes.
dynamics: A tree can be dropped to create a shortcut; logs can be released as a lethal hazard.
connections: Shares jungle imagery with The Hunted.
easter_eggs: Contains a hidden monkey-with-a-saw gag.

name: Siege
description: Abandoned industrial island with damaged structures, rail equipment, cliffs and exposed lanes.
dynamics: A rail car can be repositioned; a Field Order can call a Missile Strike against exposed enemies.
connections: Fits the Federation Gulf infrastructure seen in the campaign.
easter_eggs: A teddy bear is hidden inside a metal pipe.

name: Sovereign
description: Federation tank assembly facility with industrial lanes, machinery, catwalks and assembly-line cover.
dynamics: The assembly line moves tanks and blocks routes; a reward can fill areas with gas and alter traversal.
connections: Brazilian industrial setting connects with Federation weapons infrastructure.
easter_eggs: A hard-hat teddy bear and hidden message can be found.

name: Stonehaven
description: Ruined castle and surrounding highland fields, cliffs and open approaches.
dynamics: A large castle gate can be dropped and reopened with explosives.
connections: One of Ghosts' most open multiplayer spaces.
easter_eggs: A crashed U.S. satellite and fictional local-history signage appear.

name: Stormfront
description: Modern city district with plazas, offices, transit infrastructure and changing storm conditions.
dynamics: Weather intensifies during play and changes the atmosphere.
connections: Returns to the San Diego area devastated during the campaign opening.
easter_eggs: A teddy bear can be spotted in distant signage; survivor writing appears on walls.

name: Strikezone
description: Baseball stadium and concourse designed for quick engagements and objective play.
dynamics: A K.E.M. Strike can destroy the stadium and permanently transform the map layout for the match.
connections: The stadium environment is associated with Struck Down.
easter_eggs: Contains hot-dog-stand voice jokes and baseball props.

name: Tremor
description: Damaged Texas urban area beside an impact crater with garages, streets and broken buildings.
dynamics: Periodic tremors shake the battlefield and activate some hazards.
connections: Shows wider U.S. devastation beyond the coastal campaign locations.
easter_eggs: Graffiti and survivor-style messages include regional jokes.

name: Warhawk
description: Evacuated small-town streets, shops and alleys damaged by continuing mortar fire.
dynamics: Random mortars damage the environment; a Field Order can trigger sustained bombardment.
connections: Represents the ruined American home front.
easter_eggs: Multiple garden gnomes are hidden around the map.

name: Whiteout
description: Snow-covered Alaskan outpost with frozen water, cabins, oil infrastructure and broken terrain.
dynamics: A Satellite Crash reward creates an EMP-like zone and continued SAT COM support.
connections: Its frozen atmosphere foreshadows Nightfall's Alaskan setting.
easter_eggs: Includes a snowman and lethal helicopter-rotor hazard.

name: Free Fall
description: Interior of a collapsing skyscraper wedged between other high-rises.
dynamics: The structure shifts during play; a K.E.M. Strike creates a darker damaged state.
connections: Uses Caracas skyscraper imagery associated with Federation Day.
easter_eggs: The unstable building itself is the map's central environmental gimmick.

name: Fog
description: Foggy woodland/camp environment with caves, cabins and dense vegetation inspired by slasher films.
dynamics: A unique Field Order lets the player become Michael Myers and changes the music.
connections: One of Ghosts' strongest crossover-style map gimmicks.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg for the Onslaught Egg Hunt.

name: BayView
description: Seaside boardwalk and marina with gift shops, aquarium spaces, rooftops and coastal lanes.
dynamics: A moving trolley provides cover; Field Orders can call artillery from an offshore destroyer.
connections: Adds a civilian California coastal location to multiplayer.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg hidden around the pier.

name: Containment
description: War-torn town split by a dry riverbed and centered on a bridge carrying radioactive material.
dynamics: The hazardous central truck and elevated roofs shape movement and sightlines.
connections: Builds on damaged Federation-region environments.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg.

name: Ignition
description: Aging space-launch facility with warehouses, trenches, crawler equipment and underground routes.
dynamics: Rocket test engines and a failed launch create major hazards.
connections: Reimagines Scrapyard from Modern Warfare 2.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg after the rocket event.

name: Behemoth
description: Battlefield on a gigantic excavation vehicle with narrow decks, machinery and interior control spaces.
dynamics: Its Field Order provides an attack-helicopter reward.
connections: Unique industrial setting centered on an enormous excavation machine.
easter_eggs: Contains a Devastation Extinction Egg.

name: Ruins
description: Jungle-covered mountaintop Mayan ruins with temple spaces, underground areas and a threatening volcano.
dynamics: Map events and rewards use the volcanic/temple environment.
connections: Combines Federation-region geography with adventure-film imagery.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg and hidden map secrets.

name: Unearthed
description: Abandoned Project Nightfall excavation site filled with Cryptid artifacts and research equipment.
dynamics: A Field Order can unleash Seeker Cryptids; a crane puzzle can expose a Venom-X pickup.
connections: Reimagines Dome from Modern Warfare 3 and directly connects multiplayer with Extinction lore.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg and Venom-X Easter egg.

name: Collision
description: Cargo ship wrecked into the Brooklyn Bridge, with containers, damaged decks and bridge debris forming lanes.
dynamics: Its Field Order grants A-10 strafing runs.
connections: Echoes remotely controlled air support used in the campaign.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg and small toy/teddy-bear details.

name: Pharaoh
description: Abandoned archaeological site around an ancient Egyptian palace, temples and chambers.
dynamics: Collapsing structures, scarab-filled urns and traps reward map knowledge.
connections: A stylized archaeology setting distinct from the military campaign.
easter_eggs: Anubis imagery and hidden site secrets are integrated into the map.

name: Departed
description: Rural Mexican town during Día de los Muertos with decorated streets, vendors and storefronts.
dynamics: The unique Field Order unlocks the Death Mariachi reward.
connections: Strong festival styling gives the map a distinctive identity.
easter_eggs: Contains themed props, chickens and an Extinction Egg.

name: Mutiny
description: Hidden pirate cove with abandoned trading posts, prison cells, docks and twisting pathways.
dynamics: The dense pirate hideout favors movement, flanking and short-range weapons.
connections: A theatrical pirate setting compared with the campaign's military realism.
easter_eggs: Hidden skeleton/pirate details, a gnome and an Extinction Egg appear.

name: Favela
description: Dense hillside neighborhood with rooftops, alleys, shops and layered elevation.
dynamics: The map-specific reward gives control of a heavy gunship.
connections: A refreshed remake of Favela from Modern Warfare 2.
easter_eggs: Contains soccer details and an Extinction Egg.

name: Dynasty
description: Lakeside Chinese market village with lanterns, waterside buildings, tunnels and open lanes.
dynamics: A unique airstrike reward can be earned through its Field Order.
connections: One of Nemesis' original maps with a historic-village aesthetic.
easter_eggs: Contains dragons, lanterns, chickens, a teddy bear and an Extinction Egg.

name: Goldrush
description: Mining complex of tunnels, machinery, wooden structures and mine-cart routes.
dynamics: Mine equipment and tracks shape traversal through underground and industrial lanes.
connections: Part of Nemesis' deliberately varied final multiplayer set.
easter_eggs: Contains a hidden Extinction Egg.

name: Showtime
description: Arena/stadium reinterpretation of the classic Shipment layout.
dynamics: Field Order effects include automated defenses, care packages and gas that pushes combat inward.
connections: Reimagines Shipment from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg and arena-show details.

name: Subzero
description: Cold-weather submarine installation with military buildings, ice and exposed exterior lanes.
dynamics: The layout mixes narrow interiors with vulnerable exterior approaches.
connections: Completes Nemesis' geographically diverse original maps.
easter_eggs: Contains an Extinction Egg.

name: Point of Contact
description: First Extinction map: Task Force Spectre destroys Cryptid Hives across three main areas before a nuclear countdown and escape.
dynamics: Fourteen Hives including Barrier Hives structure the route; enemy types escalate through the map.
connections: Introduces Hive drilling, Search Piles, challenges and skill-point progression.
easter_eggs: The escape sequence sends the squad back through earlier areas under heavy pressure.

name: Nightfall
description: Episode at an abandoned Alaskan Nightfall Program facility, expanding Samantha Cross and David Archer's story.
dynamics: Adds major boss encounters and structured research-complex progression.
connections: Deepens Project Nightfall lore and introduces Venom-X.
easter_eggs: Intel files and special Easter eggs expand the hidden backstory.

name: Mayday
description: CIF Team 1 investigates the Stormbreaker vessel while pursuing Cross and the Nightfall story.
dynamics: Shipboard areas, crafting-style interactions and the Kraken boss define the episode.
connections: Continues the Medusa/Cortex narrative directly after Nightfall.
easter_eggs: Kassar cinematics and additional intel are hidden across the episode.

name: Awakening
description: The team descends beneath Ball's Pyramid into an Ancestor Ark and alien environment.
dynamics: Introduces more powerful Ancestor enemies and vertical underground traversal.
connections: Expands the origin and scale of the Cryptid/Ancestor conflict.
easter_eggs: Story intel is distributed through computers and Search Piles.

name: Exodus
location: Exodus launch facility / defended city zone
description: Final Ghosts Extinction episode centered on the Medusa Device, evacuation and large Cryptid/Ancestor assaults.
dynamics: The finale combines defensive objectives, Ancestor combat and the closing Medusa sequence.
connections: Concludes the main Ghosts Extinction arc and leaves links used by later Call of Duty material.
easter_eggs: Includes the secret Always Hard intel via the NEVERSOFT letter Easter egg.
